limitations: The preserved 1.0 registry is a historical planning snapshot and is not a complete live-source reconciliation.
The audit did not have a complete current OpenAI Sites management inventory.
Short Git and deployment prefixes are not promoted to exact commit or deployment identities.
Repository existence does not prove deployment or product release state.
Ten team projects were visible, but several source identities were available only as short prefixes and the Gateway preview exposed no Git SHA metadata.
Sites version 80 is a saved source checkpoint and was not deployed.

principles: One governed intelligence, many sovereign stores, minimum necessary context.
Core records identity, provenance, policy, authority, and receipts rather than absorbing raw Cell data.
Applications and external systems remain authoritative for their own operational records.
Unknown, unverified, candidate, production, and historical identities remain distinct.
A release, Sites save, commit, pull request, deployment, data schema, backup, verification, and rollback identity may not be collapsed into one version number.
